title: DashboardFreshness
description: GET /api/dashboard/freshness (feature 014): how fresh each data source is, where it came from, and how many records were left out of the figures. Same source, origin and state vocabulary as the freshness block of dashboard_indicators.v2; a failing or empty source is never shown as zero.

refreshed_at_original.description: The timestamp text exactly as the source gave it

excluded_records.description: Malformed or ambiguous records left out of the figures and held for review

local_load_excluded.description: Locally loaded products left out of the ERP figures, which are never added to them

review_list_link.description: In-app path of the review list the excluded records are linked to
